name: CloudRedirect
description: Upstream-first Steam Cloud redirection extension for Lua-managed and native games.

capabilities.reason: Render the package-owned cloud save management page in Tsuki
Install the CloudRedirect hook at Steam launch
Discover namespace apps from stplug-in scripts, luaappids.yaml, config.yaml and installed appmanifests
Persist cloud-save CAS blobs and local metadata store entries
Read locally-stored provider OAuth tokens from the legacy token store
Write the exported SLSsteam NO_CONNECTION-fallback stats blob into Steam's appcache/stats
Sync cloud saves against the user-configured provider (Google Drive, OneDrive, S3-compatible, or local disk)
Run the local OAuth-callback HTTP listener on an OS-assigned loopback port

compatibility_profiles.reason: Injected legacy code still discovers namespace apps and writes the stats blob directly under Steam's install tree instead of through operation-scoped grants
Injected legacy provider transport still resolves cloud-provider origins internally rather than through declared, grantable origins
Provider OAuth tokens are read/written by the legacy token store directly, not through a Tsuki-managed secret
